question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.**

Having a party is a bad idea **__because the neighbours are complain__**.

options.text: because the neighbours has been complaining

solution:
The correct answer is **"because the neighbours will complain."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is in present tense, so the correct option should also be in present tense.
 
• Option 2 correctly uses the future tense (will complain) to show that the neighbours have not yet complained but are likely to if a party is held.
 
• Option 3 is incorrect as it uses the present perfect tense (has been complaining), which suggests that the complaining has already taken place.
 
• Option 4 is incorrect as it uses the past tense (had complained), which suggests that the complaining has already happened and is no longer relevant.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

**Correct sentence**: *Having a party is a bad idea **because the neighbours will complain**__. *
